_help: Fill references first (ids ref-N in the order the user listed the images), validate, then add observations (obs-N), rules (rule-N), conflicts, not_derivable, palette_observed. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored by validate.

references.label: REPLACE: user's words or filename
references._help: roles: subset of color, shapes, characters, buttons, hud, popup, icons, typography, layout, motion, one owner per role; viewed_by: model-vision | human-description | none; screen_type: home, gameplay, popup, shop, other

_help_observations: {id: obs-N, category: layout|color|shape|shading|typography|component|character|motion|accessibility|iconography, statement: one claim, refs: [ref-N], evidence: region or 'user description, paragraph N' or 'n/a <reason>' when not-derivable, confidence: observed|high|assumption|not-derivable}
_help_rules: {id: rule-N, target: palette|radius|outline|shading|shadow|typography|icon|hud|popup|card|character|layout|motion|button.primary|button.secondary|button.icon|chip|tab-bar|dialog|toast|progress|reward, statement: imperative, derived_from: [obs-N], confidence: observed|high|assumption (min of derived observations), scope: global | context:<screen_type>}
_help_conflicts: {topic: lower-case noun phrase, between: [ref-N, ref-M], resolution: 'ref-N wins (role x): ...' when resolved or the question for the user when open, status: resolved | open}
_help_not_derivable: strings; static images usually need: animation timing and easing, pressed and disabled states, font family names, exact pixel values at device scale
_help_palette_observed: {hex: #RRGGBB upper-case, share: 0..1 (<= 4 decimals, sums <= 1 per ref), role_guess: background|surface|primary|secondary|accent|text|outline|shadow|highlight|unknown (always an assumption), ref: ref-N}
